name: Howling in the Hills
summary: Gnoll calls carry across the hills around Lakeshire, where Verner Osgood offers a bounty on Yowler. Stormwind's forces are stretched thin by the Blackrock orcs, leaving the town to rely on visitors against the gnolls.

sections.title: The Voice in the Heights
sections.body: Gnoll cries still echo through the Redridge hills after lesser gnolls are driven from the paths around Lakeshire. Verner Osgood, the town's farrier, knows the pack will keep raiding while its leader lives. Yowler is a huge, cunning gnoll whose calls direct the pack across the hills. Verner asks for Yowler's paw as proof that the leader has been killed and the calls silenced.

sections.title: A Town Abandoned by the Army
sections.body: Stormwind's eastern border towns face danger with little help from the kingdom's army. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and disputes over the regency have paralyzed high command. Royal soldiers are focused on the Blackrock orc clans in the north, leaving Lakeshire without defenders against gnolls. Townsfolk such as Verner Osgood arrange their own bounties to keep their homes from being overrun.

faq.answer: Yowler leads the Redridge gnolls in the hills outside Lakeshire. Verner says he is stronger and more dangerous than the common gnolls, and directs the pack against travelers and homesteads.

faq.q: Why is Verner Osgood issuing this bounty instead of the town guard?
faq.answer: Verner Osgood offers the bounty because Lakeshire's leadership and militia are overwhelmed by the Blackrock orcs. A local craftsman and stable master, he depends on safe roads for his livelihood and hires wandering mercenaries to face immediate dangers.

faq.q: Where are the Stormwind soldiers who should be protecting Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Stormwind's soldiers are occupied elsewhere. The army is in Redridge to monitor and contain the Blackrock orc clans farther up in the mountains, leaving Lakeshire without support against local wildlife, murlocs, and gnolls.

faq.q: What happens to the Redridge gnolls once Yowler is dead?
faq.answer: Yowler's death scatters the gnoll pack's command and blunts its coordinated raids on the town's borders. Gnolls remain a stubborn nuisance in Redridge's craggy heights.

faq.q: What prerequisite quests lead up to this contract?
aliases: chain for howling in the hills
faq.answer: Verner first sends you to secure horse gear in 'The Price of Shoes' and 'Return to Verner.' After you deal with underbelly scales and thin the pack in 'A Baying of Gnolls,' he offers the bounty on Yowler.

faq.q: Why does Verner need Yowler's paw as proof?
faq.answer: Verner needs Yowler's severed paw as physical proof before paying the bounty. It shows him and Lakeshire's uneasy residents that the beast whose calls echo through the hills has fallen.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you can see how Lakeshire's reliance on mercenaries reflects the strain weakening Stormwind's kingdom.
As a hunter, you can track Yowler in his mountain lair by watching for territorial marks and signs of pack behavior.
As a warrior, you face Yowler, who rules his pack through physical dominance and demands a direct clash of strength.
